scope: Authorized 100% software CAN attack simulation using python-can virtual backend; no physical vehicle or ECU.

phases.name: spoofing
phases.description: Fabricated speed frames on ID 0x100 and display-related ID 0x188; speed forced to 200 km/h.

phases.name: flooding
phases.description: Controlled high-rate fabrication using random IDs and payloads.

phases.name: recovery
phases.description: Return to normal simulated ECU traffic.

safety: Software-only virtual CAN. No hardware. No external target. No persistence beyond saved logs.
